name: How long does a cement stucco installation typically take?
description: Cement stucco installation typically takes one to three weeks for residential projects, depending on size, complexity, and weather.

mainEntity.name: How long does a cement stucco installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a cement stucco installation can vary significantly based on factors like the project size, complexity, weather conditions, and the number of layers applied. A typical residential project might take anywhere from one to three weeks. This timeframe includes preparation, application of multiple stucco coats, and necessary drying and curing times between each layer. Larger or more intricate commercial projects could take longer.
